claim: MetaId is the unified cross-domain identity: {type: MetaIdTypeEnum, ownerId, objectId, metaContent, external, typeWhenSomethingElse}, with strict constructor rules (ownerId non-null, SOMETHING_ELSE rejected, owner-only types require null objectId) and ~90 entity types in MetaIdTypeEnum.

claim: FWPermission is an 11-value enum binding each logical OS permission (LOCATION ×6 variants, CALENDAR, CONTACT, STORAGE, RECORD_AUDIO, NOTIFICATIONS) to an icon + rationale title/description + Android permission array, with SDK>=33 branching computed in the enum constructor.

claim: PermissionManager implements the full permission UX state machine: checkPermission ANDs all Android permissions in the bundle (but skips ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION, treating it as always granted), askPermissionAndroid routes to rationale dialog / settings redirect / direct request, and seen-state persists in SharedPreferences 'PermissionManager.FWPERMISSION' keyed by enum name.
observed_fact: Read the complete smali: checkPermission loop with Objects.equals check skipping ACCESS_FINE_LOCATION; askPermissionAndroid 3-branch flow (shouldRedirectToSettings → popup; !granted && shouldShowRationale && !fromRationale → popup; else requestPermissions + setHasSeenPermission); shouldShowRationale consults alwaysRequestRationalePermissions list first.
